description: This week's NFL player-prop prices, venue by venue: every Kalshi prop strike with a real two-sided book, the book consensus read at that exact strike, DraftKings/FanDuel/BetRivers lines, Novig and ProphetX exchange quotes, the Kalshi-vs-consensus gap in cents, and WHERE THE BEST PRICE for each side actually is (cents per $1 of payout, Kalshi net of fee). Free, no key. Filter by team, game, player or stat. Use for "where is the best price on Puka Nacua receiving yards", "Kalshi vs DraftKings NFL props", "NFL prop prices this week", "is Kalshi cheaper than the books".

game.description: Game anchor away-home, e.g. "ne-sea" — rows for that game only.

gapsOnly.description: Only strikes where Kalshi and the consensus are 5¢+ apart (default false).

team.description: Team abbrev (SEA, NE, LAR, JAX) — rows for that club only.
